label: z fed back as input during copy phase (from 3rd output on)
explanation: Fires only in the copy phase, on steps where the fed-back input token is z (99.9% of activations and essentially all mass have in_tok = z during copy). Never fires in the original phase (including on original z inputs) or at the delimiter. Magnitude grows with position in the copy: z at recall_idx 1 (the copy of first token) gives weak or no activation, rates and magnitude rise through recall_idx 2-8, and the strongest activations are z near the end of long sequences (to_go 0-1, L = 8-9). Restricting to recall_idx >= 2 lifts precision from 0.73 to 0.85 at small recall cost. Remaining false positives are mostly early-copy z inputs or a z right after another z, which are weak or silent.

issues: Factual claims check out on dev. The feature never fires in the original or delimiter phase. In the copy phase, 99.95% of activations have in_tok == z, and those steps carry 99.99% of the activation mass. Precision and F1 move as claimed: phase2 & z gives P 0.732 / F1 0.845, and adding recall_idx >= 2 gives P 0.854 / F1 0.900. On test the predicate scores F1 0.899 with mass recall 0.984. A z at recall_idx 1 is weak, as claimed: precision 0.19 and 1.5% of the mass.

The false positives follow a smooth trend with position, so they look like a threshold effect rather than a separate category. For a z input, precision rises with recall_idx: about 0.6-0.76 at recall_idx 2, 0.81-0.91 at 3-4, and 0.95-0.99 at 6-8. Within recall_idx 2 it also falls as to_go grows. The single worst cell is recall_idx 2 with to_go 0 (L = 3) at 0.38. Top activations are z at to_go 0-1 in long sequences, consistent with the explanation.

The explanation's account of the false positives is incomplete. The previous (fed-back) token also changes precision: after l, i, 2, y, r, a it is 0.97-0.99, but after e it is 0.45, and after w, z, u, t it is 0.62-0.68. The explanation names only 'a z right after another z'. This is still a graded effect: removing the low-precision previous tokens at early recall_idx only raises test F1 from 0.899 to 0.903, and recall drops. That is not enough to count as a missed category.
The misses on test (1.6% of mass) are almost all z at recall_idx 1, firing weakly, which matches 'weak or silent'.
